name: RIACO Frequently Bought Together for WooCommerce
author: robertoiacono

sections.description:
RIACO Frequently Bought Together for WooCommerce adds a “Frequently Bought Together” box to WooCommerce product pages, helping store owners increase average order value by suggesting related or complementary products.

Features:
– Display a customizable Frequently Bought Together box on product pages
– Increase sales with bundled product recommendations
– Seamless WooCommerce integration
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/frequently-bought-together-woo directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Configure the settings in Settings → Frequently Bought Together.
  5. Add frequently bought together products for each single product in Edit Product → Frequently Bought Together tab.
  6. (Optional) Activate the discount feature and set a discount value based on Fixed or Percentage type.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated for this plugin to work.

Is this plugin compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with HPOS.

Can I customize the Frequently Bought Together box?

Yes, the plugin provides basic customization options in WooCommerce settings or you can style as you want using css.
